facts.note: The term impostor phenomenon was introduced in an article published in 1978, titled "The Impostor Phenomenon in High Achieving Women: Dynamics and Therapeutic Intervention" by Pauline R. Clance and Suzanne A. Imes.

facts.claim: 1985년 클랜스 책으로 널리 알려짐, 1985년 클랜스 척도(CIPS)
facts.note: In 1985, Clance published a book on the topic, and the phenomenon became widely known. / In 1985, the Clance Impostor Phenomenon Scale (CIPS) was developed.

facts.claim: 처음엔 고성취 여성, 뒤 연구에서 남녀 모두 널리
facts.note: Initially, Clance identified the syndrome with high-achieving professional women, but later studies found that it is widespread in both men and women and in many professional settings.

question.hintNote: The impostor phenomenon is common among students entering new academic environments and has been associated with concerns about academic preparedness and comparisons with peers.
